title: Places that must compute the same metric fingerprint (saved vs inline)
answers: How do saved and inline metrics get resolved for recalculation?
Why does the frontend get query.fingerprint for saved metrics?
body:
All callers must pass identical inputs (start_date, `get_experiment_stats_method`, exposure_criteria, only_count_matured_users, excluded_variants) and hash the same metric dict:
1. Stored `metric["fingerprint"]`: written on create/update, re-derived on launch (`experiment_service.py` `_recompute_fingerprints`; also `legacy_migration.py`).
2. Saved metrics: `presentation/serializers.py:ExperimentSerializer.to_representation` injects `query.fingerprint` at read time (not stored); frontend needs it for timeseries.
3. Discovery/sync: `timeseries_sync.py:sync_timeseries_recalculation`.
4. Recalc calculate: `temporal/recalculation_logic.py`.
5. Read-back: `recalculation.py:_recalc_fingerprints_for_run` + cold-start fallback. Hazard: derived from mutable experiment fields, so changes between write and read diverge.
Saved vs inline: `temporal/metric_resolution.py:find_metric_dict/iter_metric_dicts` resolve uuid across both; saved get `_merge_saved_metric_breakdowns` (breakdowns from link.metadata). Serializer/discovery hash raw saved query, recalc hashes merged dict; `_strip_empty_breakdowns` reconciles (test `test_only_real_breakdowns_change_the_fingerprint`). Saved primary/secondary comes from `ExperimentToSavedMetric.metadata["type"]` (default primary) in `discover_experiment_metrics`. `is_scheduled_metric` / `is_daily_timeseries_metric` gate scheduling (retention excluded from daily).
applies: Any change to fingerprint inputs or normalization; frontend keys by metric uuid (metric_uuid in polled results, experimentMetricsLogic.ts).
